title: pickup.fact.handover_completed v1 payload
description: ADR-0009 C11 — Pickup-owned custody-releasing hub handover fact. Minimum fields Shipment persists to move custody from PICKUP_DRIVER to ORIGIN_HUB without reading the Pickup database.

pickup_task_id.description: PickupTask aggregate id; MUST equal envelope aggregate_id.

shipment_id.description: Payload correlation only — not Shipment aggregate authority.

handover_manifest_id.description: Pickup-owned hub handover manifest the parcel was released on.

receiving_hub_id.description: Hub that physically received the parcel. For WRONG_HUB_RECEIVED this is the actual receiving hub, not the planned one.

outcome.description: Custody-releasing outcomes only. A parcel listed but not produced (MISSING) MUST NOT use this event type — it stays in pickup-driver custody.

discrepancy_reason.description: Required when outcome is RECEIVED_WITH_DISCREPANCY. MISSING_FROM_DRIVER is not a releasing reason.

released_at.description: Operational hub receipt timestamp from Pickup (RFC 3339 UTC). Shipment sets custody_transferred_at from this value.

releasing_driver_user_id.description: Driver whose custody ends. Shipment verifies this equals its current_custody_id before applying.

receiving_actor_id.description: Hub-scoped actor that recorded the receipt. Shipment persists as audit actor_id. MUST NOT equal releasing_driver_user_id.
